content-faq.title: Questions
content-faq.description: x-faq-list: native disclosures, with FAQPage data built from the same list
content-faq.html:
Questions about VAT in Germany

What is the VAT rate in Germany?

The standard VAT rate in Germany is 19%. Reduced rates of 7% apply to selected goods and services.

How do I add VAT to a price in Germany?

Multiply the net price by 1.19. For example, €100.00 plus 19% VAT is €119.00.

How do I remove VAT from a price in Germany?

Divide the price including VAT by 1.19. For example, €100.00 including 19% VAT is €84.03 before VAT.

Calculation reference

Adding 19% VAT

Net × 1.19 = gross

€100.00 → €119.00

Removing 19% VAT

Gross ÷ 1.19 = net

€100.00 → €84.03
